form.title: Kettlebell Lifestyle intake
form.introduction: Thirteen quick steps so we can drop you into the right level of Kettlebell Lifestyle.

steps.intro: We start with the basics so we can drop you into the right level of Kettlebell Lifestyle.
steps.title: Your kettlebell history

questions.label: Have you ever used a kettlebell before?

steps.intro: Not sure? Use the intermediate movement standards as your guide — squats, two hand swings, deadlifts and overhead presses should feel proficient, not new.
steps.title: Describe your kettlebell level

options.label: Beginner
bullets: I’ve rarely used a kettlebell before

options.label: Intermediate
bullets: I use a kettlebell fairly often
I feel proficient with squats, two hand swings, deadlifts and overhead presses

options.label: Medium
bullets: I’m in decent shape, and/or I train with resistance at least 2x/week

options.label: High
bullets: My fitness is on the higher side, and/or I train with resistance 3+ times a week

questions.label: How long have you been consistently exercising?

steps.intro: This tells us how much prep and mobility work to weave into your on-ramp.
steps.title: Joint mobility

questions.label: Do your shoulder(s) feel limited or restricted in some way?
Do your hip(s) feel limited or restricted in some way?

steps.title: What do you want to improve most?

questions.label: What areas of your training, ability, or lifestyle do you wish to improve upon most?
Are you drinking at least half an ounce of quality filtered water per pound of bodyweight a day?

note.title: Questions to consider on sleep quality
points: Do you fall asleep easily (~30 minutes or less)?
Are you waking up multiple times a night?
Do you wake up in the morning feeling rested?

questions.label: Do you get 7+ hours of quality sleep per night?
How would you describe your nutrition and digestion?

options.label: Above average
bullets: Food leaves me energised, with regular, easy to pass bowel movements

options.label: Average
bullets: I generally eat clean, but certain foods affect my digestion adversely

options.label: Below average
bullets: I don’t eat the greatest, and/or often experience digestive discomfort

questions.label: How would you describe your daily stress level?

options.label: Moderate
bullets: I’m sometimes stressed, but I manage it well

options.label: High
bullets: I feel stressed a majority of the time

questions.label: How well do you manage your stress on a daily basis?
Do you feel you have a good work-life balance?
How comfortable do you feel being alone?

options.label: Not very / uncertain
bullets: I’ve never paid attention to this and am not sure

options.label: Mildly
bullets: I don’t feel comfortable unless I’m around others, or have the TV or radio on

options.label: Super comfortable
bullets: I can sit quietly or meditate with no distractions for an hour

note.title: Not sure?
